urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS pages to inspect. Up to 100 unique URLs per run.

max_links_per_page.title: Maximum returned links per page
max_links_per_page.description: Maximum number of structured link records returned for each page.

deduplicate.title: Deduplicate target URLs
deduplicate.description: Return only the first occurrence of each normalized target URL.

include_non_http.title: Include non-HTTP links
include_non_http.description: Include mailto:, tel:, javascript:, and other non-HTTP href values.

include_fragments.title: Keep URL fragments
include_fragments.description: Keep #fragment components in normalized HTTP/HTTPS URLs.

timeout_seconds.title: Per-URL timeout
timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time allowed for each individual page fetch.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Maximum number of pages fetched concurrently.
